sloka: वसिष्ठो भरतम् वाक्यम् उत्थाप्य तम् उवाच ह ।त्रयोदशोऽयम् दिवसः पितुर्वृत्तस्य ते विभो ॥२-७७-२२॥
transliteration: vasiṣṭho bharatam vākyam utthāpya tam uvāca ha ।trayodaśo'yam divasaḥ piturvṛttasya te vibho ॥2-77-22॥

translations.english: O lord, this is the thirteenth day since the death of your father. The heap of bones and ashes still remain on the pyre. Why this delay on your part?
